_comment: Source of truth for certification tracks. Edit this file to add/modify tracks. _build/build_tracks_manifest.py validates every hub_slug against the exercise manifest and emits functions/_data/tracks.json which the runtime bundles into the Function. Threshold 0.8 = 80% of all exercises across listed hubs must be passed.

issuer.name: r-statistics.co
issuer.description: Educational resource for machine learning and statistical computing in R, founded and authored by Selva Prabhakaran.

tracks.name: R Fundamentals
tracks.tagline: The R language, end to end. Vectors, control flow, functions, errors, OOP basics.
tracks.description: Demonstrates working command of base R: vectors and data types, control structures, function authorship and scoping, error handling, environment internals, and the foundations needed for any downstream R work.

tracks.name: Tidyverse Practitioner
tracks.tagline: Daily-driver data wrangling in R: dplyr, tidyr, stringr, lubridate, purrr.
tracks.description: Demonstrates fluent everyday data manipulation in R using the tidyverse: data reshaping, joins, window functions, string operations, date arithmetic, and functional pipelines.

tracks.name: Data Visualization with R
tracks.tagline: ggplot2 grammar, themes, faceting, interactive maps and tables.
tracks.description: Demonstrates command of the ggplot2 grammar of graphics: chart construction, customisation through themes and scales, faceting strategies, interactive plotting with plotly, geographic visualisation with leaflet, and presentation-quality tables with gt.

tracks.name: Statistics for Data Science
tracks.tagline: Inference, regression, ANOVA, categorical analysis — statistically grounded modelling.
tracks.description: Demonstrates working command of applied statistics in R: hypothesis testing, linear and logistic regression, ANOVA, categorical data analysis, model diagnostics, and assumption checking.

tracks.name: Machine Learning with R
tracks.tagline: End-to-end predictive modelling in R: tidymodels, caret, trees, ensembles, clustering, dimensionality reduction.
tracks.description: Demonstrates working command of applied machine learning in R: the tidymodels and caret workflows, decision trees and ensembles (random forest, XGBoost), unsupervised methods (clustering, PCA), and resampling-based model evaluation.
